studies.title: The potato
studies.caption: Below the leaves, potato plants store food in underground tubers. In the high Andes, these became a dependable crop where many other staples struggled.
studies.prompt: Ground-level botanical field study of a lifted potato plant, leafy stems and a few pale purple five-petalled flowers above, several modest varied-colour tubers attached by thin underground stolons exposed on loose soil beside it. Andean terrace blurred behind. Solanum tuberosum, not sweet potato, no root cutaway diagram.
